title: Powerstone
alias: Also known as Tower: The Gathering
summary: Command three lanes in a turn-based duel. Spend mana, combine Tower-inspired cards, and break the enemy Nexus before your own tower falls.
about: Command three lanes in a turn-based duel. Spend mana, combine Tower-inspired cards, and break the enemy Nexus before your own tower falls.
An independent mini game inspired by The Tower. Play the browser version, or explore the rest of Tower Arcade for another kind of challenge.

features.title: Three lanes
features.text: Choose where to commit your cards across the battlefield.

features.title: Mana and combinations
features.text: Spend mana on cards that work together.

features.title: Nexus defense
features.text: Bring down the enemy Nexus while protecting your own tower.

steps.title: Read the battlefield
steps.text: Check your hand, mana, and the state of all three lanes.

steps.title: Play your cards
steps.text: Spend mana and combine cards to build your attack and defense.

steps.title: End your turn
steps.text: Resolve the next exchange and work toward breaking the enemy Nexus.

controls.action: Play cards + end turn · mouse or touch
Use the game’s menus to start a run and see its available options.

availability: Available to play in your browser on desktop and mobile. The Play button opens the game.
controlNote: The game’s own controls and menus provide any additional bindings.
